title: The Community Support and Recovery Act
resumeExecutif: Interdit l'établissement de sites de consommation supervisée à moins de 400 mètres de garderies et d'écoles, et encadre l'approbation des demandes d'exemption fédérale.
resumeExecutifEn: Restricts where supervised drug consumption sites can be located and requires government approval for local authorities to seek or support such sites.
titleEn: The Community Support and Recovery Act

title: The Saskatchewan Assistance (Direct Payment of Rent and Utilities) Amendment Act
resumeExecutif: Oblige le versement direct des prestations de loyer et de services publics au propriétaire ou au fournisseur, sauf demande contraire de la personne.
resumeExecutifEn: Requires that assistance payments for rent and utilities be paid directly to landlords and utility providers unless the recipient requests otherwise.
titleEn: The Saskatchewan Assistance (Direct Payment of Rent and Utilities) Amendment Act

title: The Workers' Compensation (Strengthening Compensation Outcomes) Amendment Act, 2026
resumeExecutif: Modifie la loi sur l'indemnisation des travailleurs pour élargir la reconnaissance des blessures psychologiques et ajuster plusieurs règles de compensation.
resumeExecutifEn: Amends Saskatchewan's workers' compensation law to update psychological injury presumptions, appeal timelines, board responsibilities and payment rules.
titleEn: The Workers' Compensation (Strengthening Compensation Outcomes) Amendment Act, 2026

title: The Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy (Accountability and Transparency) Amendment Act
resumeExecutif: Modifie la loi sur l'accès à l'information pour éliminer les frais de demande, forcer la publication des réponses et renforcer les pouvoirs du commissaire.
resumeExecutifEn: Amends Saskatchewan's freedom of information law to remove fees, require proactive publication of records, and strengthen the Information Commissioner's enforcement powers.
titleEn: The Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy (Accountability and Transparency) Amendment Act
